why.faqEyebrow: A few things you might be wondering

questions.question: Does a doula replace my medical provider?
questions.answer: No. A doula offers nonmedical emotional, practical, and informational support. Your midwife or doctor remains responsible for clinical decisions and medical care.

questions.question: Will my partner still be involved?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Doula support can help your partner feel more comfortable and involved, with practical suggestions and room to rest. We work together around your preferences.

questions.question: What if my birth plans change?
questions.answer: You still deserve consistent care. Support can adapt as your preferences and circumstances change, including when you need to talk through questions with your clinical team.

questions.question: When should I reach out?
questions.answer: You can get in touch whenever you begin thinking about support. A free consultation is a chance to explore your needs and confirm availability.
